app.name: Shelf
app.summary: Shelf is a reading list for one reader at a time. You add the books you mean to read, keep each on a shelf that says where you are with it, and find them again by title or author. Nothing else gets in the way.
app.audience: People who read a lot and lose track of what they wanted to read next.

vocabulary.description: A book the reader wants to read, is reading or has finished.
Where a book stands: to read, reading or finished.

capabilities.note: Each reader signs in to see their own list.
Books belong to the reader who added them.
Find a book by title or author.
No cover images in the MVP.

inScope: Sign up and sign in with email and password
Add a book with a title, an author and a shelf
Browse the list and search it by title or author

outOfScope.reason: File uploads are not supported in the MVP.
outOfScope.placeholder: The website shows the title and author as text.

assumptions.text: A reader keeps one list; there are no shared lists.
A reader fixes a mistake by deleting the Book and adding it again; editing a Book comes after the MVP.

questions.question: Should a reader be able to rate a finished book?
questions.whyItMatters: A rating adds a field and a place to show it.
questions.defaultAnswer: No; the shelf alone says where the reader is with a book.
